preconditions.description: The length of the string S must be between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abc' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S must only contain the characters 'a', 'b', and 'c'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of valid subsequences modulo 10^9 + 7.
